```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Comprehensive root-level comment covering all rare constructs -->
  <ns2:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with complex <tags> & entities inside &ent; ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Root Catalog">
  <!ENTITY comp "&base; Extension">
  <!ENTITY % extents "<!ENTITY inner 'Nested Parameter Text'>">
  %extents;
]>
<?xml-process-instruction target="validation" status="active"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment before item list containing CDATA -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[ <item-data>∁</item-data> &inner; ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY text-ent "Default Text Content">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY binary-data SYSTEM "file.bin" NDATA bin>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <dc:title>Document Title</dc:title>
  <file>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw bytes representation: &text-ent;
    ]]>
  </file>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "&ent-a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-pi-custom action="initialize" param="true"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://xml.example.org/math">
  <!-- Section comment with CDATA payload -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      Section CDATA content: &ent-b;
    ]]>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-ref "Item Reference">
  <!ENTITY % subset "<!ENTITY nested 'Subset Entity'>">
  %subset;
]>
<?xml-space preserve?>
<inventory xmlns="http://xml.example.org/inv" xmlns:loc="http://xml.example.org/loc">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <loc:stock loc:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Stock tracking data &nested; and &item-ref;
    ]]>
  </loc:stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY core "Core Entity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&core; with Extra">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
<registry xmlns="http://xml.example.org/reg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Registry metadata comment -->
  <entry xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="manual.pdf">
    <![CDATA[
      Registry CDATA block: &extended;
    ]]>
  </entry>
</registry>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task)*>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY task-name "Build Task">
  <!ENTITY % task-macro "<!ENTITY task-status 'Pending'>">
  %task-macro;
]>
<?xml-build-info version="1.0" timestamp="2023-10-01"?>
<project xmlns="http://xml.example.org/proj" xmlns:p="http://xml.example.org/proj/meta">
  <!-- Project tracking comment with CDATA inside -->
  <p:task p:priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      Task details: &task-name; is &task-status;
    ]]>
  </p:task>
</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref-one "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ref-two "&ref-one; Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION text-not SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY ext-data SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA text-not>
]>
<?xml-debug-mode enabled="true"?>
<container xmlns="http://xml.example.org/cont" xmlns:val="http://xml.example.org/val">
  <!-- Container comment block -->
  <val:data val:secure="yes">
    <![CDATA[
      Container CDATA payload: &ref-two;
    ]]>
  </val:data>
</container>
```
